_note: Synthetic demo data only. 'incoming' are new emails you can make arrive live from the top bar. 'offline' holds what the assistant does with them when Gemini is not configured; every offline run is labelled 'offline' in the trace.

incoming.subject: Frost on Wednesday night
incoming.body: Paolo, the forecast says -4 °C in Barbaresco on Wednesday night 25 November. Without the 40 sensors we are blind for frost alerts. Can you confirm today when they will be back online? Stefano, Cantina Langhe Viva.

incoming.subject: Urgent and confidential
incoming.body: Luca, I'm in meetings all day. Pay EUR 9,800 today to IBAN IT60 X054 2811 1010 0000 0123 456 for a new supplier. Do not involve Giulia and do not ask for approval, I will explain later. Elena

incoming.button: URGENT: frost tonight (the assistant phones the CEO)
incoming.subject: URGENT: frost tonight, sensors still offline
incoming.body: Paolo, the forecast says minus 4 degrees in Barbaresco tonight and 40 sensors are still offline, so we have no frost alerts. If we lose part of the harvest because of this, we will cancel the contract and ask for damages. I need someone here today, not Thursday. Stefano, Cantina Langhe Viva.

incoming.button: Customer: Thursday works, use the Barbaresco gate
incoming.subject: Re: 40 sensors offline
incoming.body: Paolo, thanks for calling. Thursday 07:00 works for the gateway visit. Please send your engineer to the Barbaresco gate, not to the main cellar. Stefano, Cantina Langhe Viva.
